They also suggest that all of Jefferson County, Tex., be included in the Beaumont zone. A review of the present Beaumont zone and the proposed redefinition indicates that a portion of eastern Orange County is within the present zone but has been inadvertently omitted from the proposed new zone. Therefore, we shall redescribe the zone to include all points in Orange County. Furthermore, we believe that inclusion of all points in Jefferson County, while not greatly expanding the proposal in the Interim Report, will further our policy of simplifying zone descriptions. The Lake Charles parties point out that a part of Calcasieu Parish, La., which is presently within the Lake Charles commercial zone is omitted from the zone by the proposed section 1048.4. In keeping with our stated intention herein, we shall redescribe this zone so as not to exclude this area which is within the present zone.
We have determined that application of the population-mileage formula to Albany, N.Y., will result in the exclusion of an area from the expanded zone which is a part of the present zone. Therefore, we have also redescribed the Albany commercial zone so that it will include all areas encompassed by the present zone description. We have also determined that the description of the Seattle commercial zone contained in the Interim Report inaccurately describes the portion of King County, Wash., included within that zone, and we have redescribed the zone's boundary to conform to the evidence.
